prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case and what you need (trial experience, a local presence, language ability, budget, etc.). I can help you find a great lawyer, but first here’s how to choose one and what to look for.

What matters most
- Experience with car-accident cases like yours (minor injury vs. catastrophic injury/wrongful death).  
- Trial experience and a track record of verdicts and large settlements (not just small claims).  
- Resources to investigate and litigate (medical experts, accident reconstruction).  
- Board certification: Texas Board of Legal Specialization certification in Personal Injury Trial Law is a strong plus.  
- Clear fee structure (typically contingency, often 33%–40% depending on whether the case goes to trial) and transparency about costs.  
- Good communication and someone who will actually handle your file (not hand you to a paralegal).  
- Clean disciplinary record with the State Bar of Texas.

Where to search and verify credentials
- State Bar of Texas lawyer search (for license and discipline info).  
- Houston Bar Association referral service.  
- Peer-review listings like Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell.  
- Client-review sites (Avvo, Google reviews) — read multiple reviews, not just one.  
- Ask local doctors, ER staff, or accident reconstruction specialists for recommendations.

Questions to ask in an interview
- How long have you handled car-accident cases? How many per year?  
- How many cases have you taken to trial and what were the results?  
- Have you handled cases with injuries similar to mine? Can you share typical outcomes?  
- Who in your office will handle my case day-to-day? Who will I communicate with?  
- What is your fee and how are costs advanced/handled?  
- How long do you estimate until resolution?  
- Will you obtain independent medical exam/history and expert witnesses if needed?  
- Can you provide references from recent clients?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific outcome or settlement amount.  
- Requests for large up-front retainers for standard car-accident representation.  
- Poor communication during initial contact or reluctance to put key terms in writing.  
- No courtroom experience if your case may require trial.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of highly rated Houston personal injury attorneys tailored to your needs (catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, minor injuries, Spanish-speaking, etc.).  
- Look up a specific lawyer’s background and disciplinary history.  
Tell me your ZIP code, a brief summary of the crash and injuries, and any other priorities (trial lawyer, language, budget), and I’ll pull a focused shortlist.
